className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

content.zh-CN: 显示的按键文字，缺省显示 hotKeys。
content.en-US: Key labels to show. Defaults to hotKeys.

getListenerTarget.zh-CN: 返回监听 keydown 的元素；缺省或返回 null、undefined 时使用 document.body。挂载后会再读取一次，因此读取父容器的 ref 也能取到元素；返回的元素变化后监听随之切换。
getListenerTarget.en-US: Returns the element that listens for keydown. When omitted, or when it returns null or undefined, document.body is used. It is read again after mount, so a ref of a parent container works; the listener moves when the returned element changes.

hotKeys.zh-CN: 快捷键组合：任意个修饰键（`Shift`、`Control`、`Meta`、`Alt`）加一个普通键，取值参考 `KeyboardEvent.key`，按物理按键位置匹配。组合不合法时抛错，更新后同样校验。
hotKeys.en-US: Key combination: any number of modifiers (`Shift`, `Control`, `Meta`, `Alt`) plus one other key, as `KeyboardEvent.key` values matched by physical key position. An invalid combination throws, including after an update.

onHotKey.zh-CN: 按下完整的快捷键组合时调用，参数为原生 `KeyboardEvent`。
onHotKey.en-US: Called when the full key combination is pressed, with the native `KeyboardEvent`.

preventDefault.zh-CN: 是否阻止快捷键的默认行为。
preventDefault.en-US: Whether the default behavior of the key combination is prevented.

ref.zh-CN: 根元素（`div`）的引用。`render` 为 `null` 或返回 `null` 时不渲染根元素，引用为 `null`。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root `div` element. When `render` is `null` or returns `null` no root element is rendered, and the reference is `null`.

render.zh-CN: 替换按键提示的渲染，可以是 React 节点或返回 React 节点的函数。传入 `null` 或返回 `null` 时不渲染根元素，快捷键仍然有效。
render.en-US: Replaces the key hint. Accepts a React node or a function returning one. `null`, or a function returning `null`, renders no root element and the hot keys stay active.
